big_case.notes: Independent read formed from the docket skeleton and the outcome before looking at any candidate's score: a paid petition by a private noncitizen against the Attorney General from an unpublished Ninth Circuit memorandum, response waived by the Solicitor General, denied at its first conference on the opening order list with no noted dissent. The underlying post-Riley v. Bondi timeliness question for reinstatement cases has some class-wide importance to the immigration bar, but this vehicle carried none of it forward. Low stakes.
